name: Apollo 2
summary: The second Apollo, and explicitly not the commercial one — Apptronik calls it a training and data-collection platform and points at Apollo 3, due 2027, as the first product. It comes as a biped or on a wheeled base, and fleets of it run across the company's Robot Park network and partner sites gathering task data.
notable: Positioned as a data-collection platform rather than a product
Offered as either a biped or on a wheeled base
